Let \(N_n\) be the number of solutions to \(f_n(x)=-\frac12\), where \(f_n\) is the \(n\)-fold iterate.

Since \(f(y)=|y|-1=-\frac12\) iff \(|y|=\frac12\), we get
\[
N_n = \#\{f_{n-1}(x)=\tfrac12\}+\#\{f_{n-1}(x)=-\tfrac12\}.
\]
For every \(k\ge 1\), the equation \(f_k(x)=\frac12\) has exactly \(2\) solutions: solving backward gives only the positive branch, and ultimately \(|x|=\frac{2k+1}{2}\).

Thus
\[
N_n=N_{n-1}+2.
\]
With \(N_1=2\), this gives
\[
N_n=2n.
\]
For \(n=10\),
\[
N_{10}=20.
\]

\[
\boxed{20}
\]
